title: Read-only original-requirement/source coverage: MC06 and MC10
method: Accepted original briefs and applicable dependency/acceptance cases mapped to source. Archived patient-journey cases used only through their explicit adoption by current PATIENT_JOURNEY_PLAN. No score arithmetic or canonical edits. Missing code, present source, Validation, external/human, and undefined scope are separate; one row can have multiple kinds. Grouped rows are coverage units, not equal-weight scoring units.
limitations: No Ruby/PostgreSQL test runtime available; registry access blocked in earlier capability task.
No graft executable or index present; source read directly from immutable git archive.
Historical passing evidence and authored tests inspected as scope clues only, not a fresh pass.
Source-level guard gaps are inferred from executable paths; no failing runtime reproduction claimed.
Matrix reflects read-only baseline review; any later authored tests, static checks or guard repair are reported separately, not credited retroactively.
